# @ponchia/ui

> CSS building blocks for tools, dashboards, and reports. Framework-agnostic,
> with zero runtime dependencies, typed class recipes, shared design tokens,
> and optional vanilla JavaScript behaviors.
>
> This is a task router, not an API catalog. Use the installed package's
> references below for exact names and contracts; use its version when choosing
> documentation and CDN URLs.

## Choose a task

| Task | Read first |
| --- | --- |
| Build a page or choose a control | [Usage guide](docs/usage.md), then [class reference](docs/reference.md) |
| Compose an inspector, workbench, or evidence view | [Composition recipes](docs/compositions.md) |
| Produce an HTML or printed report | [Report cookbook](docs/reporting.md) |
| Add citations and claim-to-source relationships | [Report cookbook](docs/reporting.md) and `schemas/report-claims.v1.schema.json` |
| Wire a dialog, theme toggle, or other interaction | `behaviors/index.d.ts` and [integration guide](https://github.com/Ponchia/bronto-ui/blob/main/docs/integration.md) |
| Customize themes or read tokens in a renderer | [Theming](docs/theming.md) and [renderer guide](docs/renderer.md) |
| Theme a chart or diagram | [Vega](docs/vega.md), [Mermaid](docs/mermaid.md), or [D2](docs/d2.md) |
| Migrate annotation helpers or styles | [Annotations guide](docs/annotations.md) and [0.17 migration](docs/migrations/0.16-to-0.17.md) |
| Check exports, compatibility, or an upgrade | [Package contract](docs/package-contract.md) and [stability contract](docs/stability.md) |

## Loading and ownership

- Load the core once: `@ponchia/ui` is flattened CSS; `@ponchia/ui/css` is
  the source CSS import fan-out for a bundler. Pick one. The package root is
  CSS-only; runtime JavaScript must use explicit subpaths such as
  `@ponchia/ui/classes` or `@ponchia/ui/behaviors`. JS subpaths are ESM-only.
- In plain HTML, use real stylesheet URLs ending in `dist/bronto.css` or
  `dist/css/<leaf>.css`, with a pinned package version. Bare package specifiers
  in `<link href>` do not resolve in a browser. Core CSS does not include every
  report, analytical, or workbench leaf; follow the selected recipe's imports.
- Initialize behaviors after the DOM exists, in the host framework's mount
  lifecycle. Importing does not initialize them. Retain each teardown and call
  it before replacing the indexed markup or unmounting; `toast()` instead
  returns a dismiss function. The package ships no framework adapters.
- Bronto owns styles, tokens, and documented interaction wiring. Applications
  own state, routing, data fetching, permissions, selection, commands, and
  persistence. Bronto is not a chart engine or a data grid implementation.
- Annotation placement, collision handling, editing, and rendering belong to
  the independent `@ponchia/annotations` package. The UI annotation helpers and
  styles are deprecated in 0.17; follow the migration guide rather than adding
  new dependencies on that legacy surface.
  `@ponchia/ui/annotations` remains a dependency-free Bronto static-helper compatibility surface
  only during the 0.17 deprecation window.

## Validate generated or handwritten markup

After installing `@ponchia/ui`, run
`npx --no-install bronto-ui-check src index.html` with the actual source paths
in your project. Add `--json` for structured findings or `--help` for options.
The installed CLI checks literal `ui-*` names and unresolved Bronto-like
`var(--*)` references against that package's vocabulary. It exits nonzero on
findings and skips dependency and build directories.

This is a lexical source check. It does not evaluate dynamically assembled
classes, confirm that optional CSS was loaded, or verify semantics, contrast,
keyboard behavior, or screen-reader output. Review the rendered composition in
both themes and its important interaction states.

## Authoritative offline references (shipped in this package)

Paths are relative to `node_modules/@ponchia/ui/`. Read only the references
needed for the task; the package contract lists the complete export inventory.

- `docs/package-contract.md` — exports, shipped paths, and provenance gates.
- `classes/classes.json` — exact classes, groups, modifiers, parts, state hooks,
  author-set custom properties, behavior attributes, and required ARIA. A
  group's null `base` means it is a parts-only namespace; do not emit that base.
- `classes/index.d.ts` — literal `cls` names, `ui.*()` signatures, and options.
- `docs/reference.md` — generated class catalog and markup contracts.
- `behaviors/index.d.ts` — public initializer options and return types. Consult
  the implementation and behavior documentation for interaction semantics.
- `docs/usage.md` and `docs/compositions.md` — control choices and compositions.
- `docs/reporting.md` and `schemas/report-claims.v1.schema.json` — report recipes
  and the declarative claim-to-source sidecar contract.
- `docs/theming.md` and `docs/contrast.md` — theme model and verified shipped
  token pairings; custom colors require their own contrast checks.
- `docs/renderer.md` — reading live theme values for non-CSS renderers.
- `tokens/index.d.ts` and `tokens/index.json` — token names and authored data.
- `tokens/resolved.json` — resolved per-theme colors and non-color scales.
- `tokens/tokens.dtcg.json` — resolved DTCG values and authored extensions.
- `docs/mermaid.md`, `docs/d2.md`, and `docs/vega.md` — renderer theme recipes.
- `docs/annotations.md` and `docs/migrations/0.16-to-0.17.md` — annotation
  ownership and migration, including opt-in rollup imports.
- `glyphs/glyphs.d.ts` — display glyph names and renderer signatures.
- `classes/vscode.css-custom-data.json` — editor custom-property completion.
- `docs/stability.md` — versioned API, behavior trust boundary, and CSP notes.

## Authoring rules

- Never invent `ui-*` classes. Check the installed class manifest; prefer
  `ui.*()` recipes where available. Documented `is-*` state hooks are valid
  even though they are outside `cls`.
- Use semantic HTML, accessible names, and documented ARIA relationships.
  Classes alone do not make a control accessible. Use one interaction owner
  per control and preserve the host framework's cleanup lifecycle.
- Override ordinary styles outside `@layer bronto`. Theme with documented
  tokens: neutral canvas, one rationed accent, status colors for status, and
  opt-in chart colors for data. Do not substitute raw hues for semantic roles.
- Accent-derived tokens resolve at the root. A subtree `--accent` override
  does not recompute every inherited derived token. Static renderer configs
  also need explicit updates when the theme changes.
- Pre-1.0 breaking changes ship in minor releases. Pin a concrete version or
  minor-compatible range and review the migration guide before crossing a
  minor boundary; visual checks still matter on patch upgrades.

For keyboard toolbars and flat action menus, use docs/workbench.md and the
optional behaviors/toolbar and behaviors/action-menu exports. Narrow command
dialogs use docs/command.md. Activity and retained-source presentations compose
existing discussion/state/source leaves: docs/compositions.md.
